blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Many-shot in-context learning (ICL) enables large language models (LLMs) to adapt to complex tasks by conditioning on thousands of demonstration examples, but this paradigm shifts the inference efficiency bottleneck to the key-value (KV) cache memory.
Due to the linear scaling behavior of the KV cache, storing these intermediate tensors has become a paramount challenge for both online serving and on-device deployment.
To address this issue, we propose a novel compression framework, termed MILO , that exploits the low-rank redundancy inherent in many-shot contexts.
Specifically, MILO features a block-wise low-rank compression strategy that compresses the KV cache at the block granularity, where each block contains multiple many-shot examples.
Furthermore, to handle the heterogeneous context density across different blocks, MILO dynamically allocates rank budgets based on the information entropy, preserving the fidelity of critical blocks while aggressively compressing redundant ones.
Experimental results on Qwen2.5 models demonstrate that our method achieves up to 50% reduction in KV cache memory and 1.8 × \times throughput improvement, with negligible performance degradation on classification and reasoning benchmarks, significantly outperforming prior baselines.
blocks.zh:
许多shot in-context学习(ICL)使得大型语言模型(LLMs)能够通过对上千个演示实例的调制来适应复杂的任务,但这个范式将推论效率瓶颈转移到键值(KV)缓存内存.
由于KV缓存的线性缩放行为,存储这些中间的百分位数成为在线服务及在线设备部署的最大挑战.
为了解决这个问题,我们建议建立一个称为MILO的新压缩框架,利用许多情景中固有的低级冗余。
具体地说,MILO的特点是采用块形低级压缩策略,在块颗粒度压缩KV缓存,每个块都包含多个多镜头的例子.
此外,为了处理不同区块之间的不同背景密度,劳工和劳工局根据信息内涵动态地分配排名预算,保持关键区块的忠诚,同时大力压缩多余区块。
Qwen2.5模型的实验结果显示,我们的方法在KV缓存内存中实现了高达50%的减少,1.8 ×\时间的吞吐量改善,分类和推理基准上的性能退化可忽略不计,大大超过先前的基线。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
In-context learning (ICL) ( Brown et al., 2020 ; Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2024 ) is a powerful capability of large language models (LLMs) Meta (2024) ; Brown et al. (2020) ; Yang et al. (2024a) that enables the model to learn a new task at inference time by conditioning on a few demonstration examples or ‘shots’ provided directly in the prompt, without any parameter updates.
Traditionally, it has been limited to "few-shot" learning due to the small context windows of prior models Brown et al. (2020) .
However, with the recent expansion of model context windows to a million tokens or more, a new paradigm of ‘many-shot ICL’ has emerged Agarwal et al. (2024) ; Jiang et al. (2024) ; Song et al. (2024) ; Xiao et al. (2025) .
Through augmenting prompts with hundreds or even thousands of examples, many-shot ICL has been shown to significantly boost performance on complex downstream tasks, often approaching the accuracy of fully fine-tuned models Agarwal et al. (2024) ; Jiang et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh:
in-context learning(ICL)(Brown等人,2020年;Agarwal等人,2024年;Jiang等人,2024年;Song等人,2024年)是大型语言模型(LLMs)Meta(2024年);Brown等人(2020年);Yang等人(2024年a年)的强大能力,使得模型能够在推论时通过在几个演示实例或直接提供的‘弹射'条件来学习新的任务,无需任何参数更新.
传统上,由于之前的模型Brown等人(2020年)的上下文窗口很小,它仅限于"few-shot"学习.
然而,随着近期模型上下文窗口扩大到百万个或更多的信使,出现了"许多镜头的ICL"的新范式,Agarwal等人(2024年);Jiang等人(2024年);Song等人(2024年);Xiao等人(2025年)。
通过以数百个甚至数千个实例的增强提示,许多镜头的ICL被证明能显著提升复杂下游任务的性能,经常接近完全微调的模型Agarwal等人(2024年);Jiang等人(2024年)的准确性.

blocks.en:
Despite its effectiveness across a wide range of tasks, many-shot ICL introduces significant efficiency challenges for practical deployment Dong et al. (2022) ; Xiao et al. (2025) ; Golchin et al. (2025) .
Long-context inputs place significantly higher memory and compute requirements for inference due to the quadratic complexity of the attention operation and the existence of key-value (KV) cache Ott et al. (2019) .
To maintain high performance and low latency, many-shot ICL often requires careful and query-dependent example selection to construct proper inputs an Luo et al. (2024) ; Golchin et al. (2025) .
Recent works have attempted to minimize the inference costs by pre-encoding the KV cache of many-shot examples Xiao et al. (2025) ; Ou et al. (2026) .
Notably, DBSA applies dynamic sparse attention to alleviate the compute burden, and Adapshot further introduces semantic-aware KV cache reuse Ou et al. (2026) .
However, none of the prior works discuss the storage and memory efficiency aspects of the KV cache.
For instance, storing the KV cache for 90k examples necessitates an additional 11.1 GB for 8B dense models Xiao et al. (2025) .
As the long-context capabilities are continuously expanded, with models like Gemini now supporting 10M tokens, the growing memory footprint for encoding prior examples makes many-shot ICL increasingly memory-bound and impractical for serving with stringent service-level objectives (SLOs).
blocks.zh:
尽管在一系列广泛的任务中取得了成效,但许多镜头的ICL为实际部署Dong等人(2022年);Xiao等人(2025年);Golchin等人(2025年)带来了重大的效率挑战。
由于注意操作的四极复杂性以及存在密钥值(KV)缓存Ott等人(2019年),长康文字输入为推断投放了显著更高的内存和计算要求.
为了保持高性能和低耐久性,许多镜头的ICL往往需要仔细和依赖查询的示例选择来构建一个适当的输入Luo等人(2024年);Golchin等人(2025年).
近期的作品试图通过对KV缓存中许多镜头的例子进行预编码,以尽量减少推论成本. Xiao等人(2025);Ou等人(2026)。
值得注意的是,DBSA对减轻计算负担的注意很少,Adapshot进一步引入了语义意识KV缓存再利用Ou等人(2026年)。
然而,之前的作品都没有讨论KV缓存的存储和内存效率方面.
例如,为90k实例存储 KV 缓存需要为8B稠密型号Xiao et al. (2025) 追加11.1 GB.
随着长文本能力不断扩展,双子座等模型现在支持10M令牌,编码先前实例的记忆足迹越来越大,使得许多镜头的ICL对服务于严格的服务级目标(SLO)越来越具有内存约束性和不切实际.

blocks.en:
In this work, we present an efficient framework, termed MILO , to address the above-mentioned KV cache challenges in many-shot ICL. Our key idea is to exploit the observed low-rank nature of the KV cache of pre-encoded many-shot examples.
This low-rank redundancy arises because many examples share similar semantic features, leading to highly correlated representations within the KV cache in latent space. By storing the KV cache in low-dimensional space, MILO can achieve up to 50% storage cost reduction and 1.8 × \times speedup against prior works with minimal accuracy degradation.
However, achieving this performance requires solving two unique challenges.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们提出了一个称为MILO的高效框架,以应对许多镜头的ICL中的上述KV缓存挑战. 我们的关键想法是利用 KV 缓存中观察到的低级特性 预编码的多镜头实例。
这种低级冗余之所以产生,是因为许多例子具有相似的语义特征,导致KV缓存内在潜在空间中的高度相关表示. 通过在低维空间存储 KV 缓存, MILO 可以实现最高50%的存储成本降低和1.8 ×\时速加速, 与先前的作品相比, 精确度降低最小.
然而,实现这一业绩需要解决两个独特的挑战。

blocks.en:
First, it is essential to choose the appropriate granularity for low-rank compression to achieve a balance between memory efficiency and model performance.
Compression itself is a lossy process, where a naive, global approach risks losing fine-grained information across different examples and, most importantly, induces redundant computation overhead during decompression Chang et al. (2024) .
Conversely, attempting to compress on an example-by-example basis fails to capture the global semantics and results in a significant performance drop due to accumulated information loss from each example Sun et al. (2024) .
To resolve this trade-off, MILO employs a block-wise low-rank compression (BLC) method.
Specifically, the KV caches are compressed at the granularity of a block, where each block contains multiple many-shot examples.
Such a granularity can strike the best trade-offs between model accuracy and inference efficiency, thereby improving the end-to-end quality of service (QoS).
blocks.zh:
首先,必须选择适合的颗粒性进行低级压缩,以实现内存效率和模型性能之间的平衡.
压缩本身是一个亏损的过程,一种天真,全球性的方法可能在不同的例子中丢失精细的信息,最重要的是,在压抑张等人(2024年)期间诱导冗余计算间接费用.
反之,试图逐例压缩则无法捕捉到全球语义,由于每个例子Sun等人(2024年)累积的信息损失,导致性能大幅下降.
为了解决这种权衡,MILO采用了以区块为主的低级压缩法(BLC).
具体来说,KV缓存在一个块的颗粒性上被压缩,每个块都包含多个多镜头的例子.
这种颗粒性可以在模型精确度和推论效率之间取得最佳的权衡,从而改善端到端的服务质量(QoS).

blocks.en:
A second challenge lies in the fact that the information density within the KV cache is highly heterogeneous across the blocks.
While some blocks focus on local semantic patterns that are highly redundant, others often retain critical information required for tasks like complex chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning Wei et al. (2022) ; Gu et al. (2025) and test-time scaling Muennighoff et al. (2025) ; Snell et al. (2024) ; Ji et al. (2025) ; Zhao et al. (2025b) .
Applying a uniform compression rank across the entire cache is therefore often suboptimal.
To address this issue, we propose a dynamic rank adaptation mechanism that allocates higher rank budgets based on the entropy of each block and aggressively compresses redundant ones.
This ensures that the compression algorithm can preserve the fidelity of retrieval capabilities while minimizing the aggregate KV cache memory footprint.
Furthermore, we design and implement a suite of system optimizations, e.g., customized kernels and CUDA graphs and streams, tailored to MILO, to achieve real-world end-to-end benefits.
blocks.zh:
第二项挑战在于KV缓存内的信息密度在区块之间差异很大。
虽然有些块注重高度冗余的当地语义模式,但其他块则经常保留复杂思维链(CoT)推理Wei等人(2022年);Gu等人(2025年)和测试时间缩放Muennighoff等人(2025年);Snell等人(2024年);Ji等人(2025年);Zhao等人(2025年b)等任务所需的关键信息.
因此,在整个缓存中采用统一的压缩级别往往不够理想。
为了解决这一问题,我们建议建立一个动态的等级调整机制,根据每个区块的内涵分配更高等级的预算,并大力压缩多余的预算。
这保证了压缩算法能够保持检索能力的忠诚性,同时将聚合的KV缓存内存脚印降到最小.
此外,我们设计并实施了一套系统优化,如针对MILO定制的内核和CUDA图表和流,以实现现实世界的端到端效益。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows: • We identify the KV cache memory challenges in many-shot ICL and propose a new framework, termed MILO, by exploiting the low-rank redundancy inherent in the KV cache during many-shot ICL. • MILO features block-wise low-rank compression (BLC) that balances reconstruction efficiency with model representation quality, and a dynamic rank adaptation mechanism to allocate ranks based on the information entropy. • Evaluations on Qwen2.5 models demonstrate that our framework significantly reduces KV cache storage and improves inference latency with negligible accuracy degradation across a suite of standard ICL benchmarks.

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en:
Many-Shot ICL. The paradigm of in-context learning (ICL) was first popularized by GPT-3 Brown et al. (2020) , demonstrating that LLMs can adapt to new tasks by conditioning on a few demonstration examples without parameter updates.
While early work focused on standard "few-shot" settings (typically 1 ∼ \sim 8 examples) due to limited context windows (e.g., 2k or 4k tokens), the recent advent of long-context models—capable of processing up to 10M tokens—has unlocked the potential for "many-shot" ICL.
Recent studies indicate that scaling the number of demonstrations from dozens to thousands yields monotonic performance improvements, rivaling the performance of fine-tuned models on complex reasoning and extraction tasks Agarwal et al. (2024) ; Jiang et al. (2024) .

(原始内容存档于2018-09-13). Many-Shot ICL. 内容内学习(ICL)的范式最早被GPT-3 Brown 等人(2020年)普及,表明LLMS可以通过在几个没有参数更新的演示实例上进行条件调整来适应新的任务.
虽然由于上下文窗口有限(如2k或4k令牌),早期的工作侧重于标准的"few-shot"设置(典型的1 \\sim 8 例),但最近出现的长文本模型——能够处理最多10M令牌——已经解开了"many-shot"ICL的潜力.
最近的研究表明,将演示次数从数十次增加到数千次,提高了单调性能,与对复杂推理和提取任务进行微调的模型的性能形成竞争(2024年);Jiang等人(2024年)。

blocks.en:
Inference Optimization for Many-Shot ICL. Despite the promising results of many-shot ICL, this approach shifts the bottleneck from offline training to online inference, where the prompt length scales linearly with the number of shots.
The quadratic complexity of self-attention and, more critically, the linear growth of the key-value (KV) cache imposes severe memory and latency constraints Ott et al. (2019) .
Several recent works have attempted to resolve such inference challenges.
Notably, DBSA explores pre-encoding mechanisms with dynamic sparse attention to reduce compute latency Xiao et al. (2025) .
Adapshot proposes dynamic context budget allocation and KV cache reuse to further improve both accuracy performance and system throughput Ou et al. (2026) .
However, the challenge of managing the memory footprint for the cached intermediate states of thousands of examples remains an open problem that our work aims to address.

然而,管理数千个实例的缓存中间状态的记忆足迹的挑战仍然是一个我们的工作所要解决的公开问题。

blocks.en:
Low-rank Compression. Several works have explored compressing LLMs in low-rank space.
Prior efforts have generally focused on weight and activation compression using Fisher information Yuan et al. (2023) ; Hsu et al. (2022) .
Recently, as context length continues to scale up, several works aim to further compress KV cache for more efficient memory management Chang et al. (2024) ; Yu et al. (2024b) ; Lin et al. (2024) ; Saxena et al. (2024) ; Sun et al. (2024) ; Yu et al. (2024a) ; Zhang et al. (2024) .
Notably, Palu applies a low-rank projection matrix in zero-shot settings Chang et al. (2024) , and LoRC proposes inter-layer progressive compression Zhang et al. (2024) Yu et al. (2024a) explores compressing KV cache at the head level by converting multi-head attention (MHA) to group-query attention (GQA) with LoRA fine-tuning Hu et al. (2021) . However, existing works focus on the compression within a limited context window and do not consider the low-rank nature across examples.
Our work aims to extend low-rank compression to many-shot settings and fill in the gap.

我们的工作旨在将低级压缩扩展到许多镜头设置,并填补空白.

blocks.en:
Sparse Attention and Quantization. Another line of inference-time approaches is based on the observation that not all tokens are created equal, thus creating the opportunity of sparse attention. H 2 ​ O H_{2}O Zhang et al. (2023) , StreamingLLM Xiao et al. (2023) , and Scissorhands Liu et al. (2023) , aim to reduce memory by evicting tokens deemed less important, typically retaining the most important ones for token generation.
On the system level, ALISA Zhao et al. (2024) employs a co-design approach to maximize throughput performance on resource-constrained platforms.
DBSA applies a similar block sparse attention method for retrieval-based many-shot in-context learning, achieving competitive performance against fine-tuning baselines Xiao et al. (2025) .
Quantization is also a standard method for reducing KV cache memory footprint.
Techniques like KIVI Liu et al. (2024) and KVQuant Hooper et al. (2024) compress the KV cache by reducing numerical precision, storing entries in 4-bit or 2-bit formats. Orthogonal to these works, our method aims to compress the representation of the KV cache from the perspective of low-rank approximation, which can be combined with quantization and sparse attention for further gains.

blocks.en:
Here we have three key observations. First , the key cache exhibits a much stronger low-rank nature than the value cache in many-shot ICL settings, as shown in both Figure 1 and 2 .
This is consistent with prior findings that pre-RoPE keys are much better suited for low-rank compression Sun et al. (2024) . Second , counterintuitively, scaling the number of shots in ICL creates more KV storage, but simultaneously introduces more redundancy in low-rank space, as shown in Figure 1 . Third , across different blocks and different layers, the low-rank behavior is heterogeneous, as indicated in Figure 2 .
These observations both motivate and validate our solution to exploit the low-rank nature of many-shot contexts.

blocks.en: 4 Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en:
In this section, we present our framework for efficient many-shot in-context learning. We first formulate the memory bottleneck problem in standard transformer attention.
We then introduce block-wise low-rank compression, our approach for granular cache compression, and a dynamic rank allocation mechanism with efficient attention.
Next, we present some system optimization techniques for MILO.

然后,我们采用区块式低级压缩,我们采用颗粒缓存压缩的方法,并采用动态分级分配机制,高效关注.
接下来,我们为MILO介绍一些系统优化技术.

blocks.en: 4.1 Background

blocks.en:
Consider a transformer-based LLM with L L layers and H H attention heads per layer.
In the many-shot setting, the model processes a sequence of inputs X = { x 1 , … , x N } X=\{x_{1},\dots,x_{N}\} , where N N represents a long context (e.g., N > 10 5 N>10^{5} ). The standard self-attention mechanism for a specific head h h at layer l l computes the output 𝐎 h \mathbf{O}_{h} as: 𝐎 h = Attn ​ ( 𝐐 𝐡 , 𝐊 𝐡 , 𝐕 𝐡 ) = Softmax ​ ( 𝐐 h ​ 𝐊 h ⊤ d ) ​ 𝐕 h \mathbf{O}_{h}=\text{Attn}(\mathbf{Q_{h}},\mathbf{K_{h}},\mathbf{V_{h}})=\text{Softmax}\left(\frac{\mathbf{Q}_{h}\mathbf{K}_{h}^{\top}}{\sqrt{d}}\right)\mathbf{V}_{h} (1) where 𝐐 h , 𝐊 h , 𝐕 h ∈ ℝ N × d \mathbf{Q}_{h},\mathbf{K}_{h},\mathbf{V}_{h}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times d} denote the Query, Key, and Value matrices, respectively, and d d is the head dimension.
The primary bottleneck in many-shot ICL is the storage of the intermediate key-value tensors, i.e., the KV cache, ( 𝐊 , 𝐕 ) (\mathbf{K},\mathbf{V}) , which grows linearly with the sequence length N N Ott et al. (2019) .
The total memory footprint ℳ \mathcal{M} required to store the KV cache in FP16 precision is calculated as: ℳ = 2 ⋅ N ⋅ L ⋅ H ⋅ d ⋅ 2 \mathcal{M}=2\cdot N\cdot L\cdot H\cdot d\cdot 2 (2) As the number of shots continues to grow, ℳ \mathcal{M} can often exceed the high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity of modern GPUs, forcing evictions or offloading that degrade performance.

blocks.en: 4.2 Block-wise Low-Rank Compression
blocks.zh: 4.2 以块为单位的低倾压

blocks.en:
Global compression methods often treat the entire context matrix as a single entity, but this approach risks losing fine-grained details essential for many-shot ICL.
It also induces redundant computation during decoding, as only a handful of many-shot examples are selected for the entire KV cache Xiao et al. (2025) .
On the other hand, compressing each example or token leads to improved decoding efficiency, but suffers significant performance degradation, as the information loss from each example accumulates Sun et al. (2024) ; Yuan et al. (2023) .

这也在解码过程中诱导冗余计算,因为整个KV缓存Xiao et al.(2025)中只选了少数多个镜头的例子.
另一方面,压缩每个实例或符号会导致解码效率的提高,但因每个实例的信息损失积累了Sun等人(2024);Yuan等人(2023)。

blocks.en: 4.3 Dynamic Rank Allocation
blocks.zh: 4.3 动态排名分配

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 2 , the information density in many-shot prompts is highly heterogeneous.
This echoes prior works that a uniform rank allocation for the KV cache at each layer is often suboptimal Chang et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2024) .
Here, we further demonstrate that this phenomenon also extends to many-shot ICL at the block level.
Specifically, in a typical many-shot setting, the context window is populated with numerous demonstration blocks, but different blocks exhibit substantially different spectral complexity and therefore require different representation capacities under compression.
Therefore, applying a uniform rank wastes representation capacity on highly redundant blocks while under-allocating rank to information-dense blocks.

在这里,我们进一步表明,这一现象也延伸到了街区一级许多镜头的ICL.
具体来说,在一个典型的多镜头设定中,上下文窗口内布满了众多的演示块,但不同的块呈现出非常不同的光谱复杂性,因此在压缩下需要不同的表现能力.
因此,在高度冗余的区块上适用统一的废物等级代表能力,同时将等级分配到信息密集区块中。

blocks.en: 4.4 MILO Workflow
blocks.zh: 4.4 劳工组织 工作流程

blocks.en:
Combining the above two proposed techniques, we present MILO, a new framework for efficient many-shot ICL.
Figure 3 and Algorithm 1 further demonstrate the detailed workflow of our framework.
Here, for simplicity, we assume 𝐊 \mathbf{K} and 𝐕 \mathbf{V} are compressed to the same rank, while in practice they can be compressed to different ranks according to the entropy distribution.
It is divided into an encoding stage and an inference stage.
During encoding, the KV cache for a many-shot context is partitioned into multiple blocks, each containing a specific number of examples.
These blocks undergo SVD to determine an optimal rank allocation.
By analyzing the entropy of each block, the system applies low-rank compression based on assigned rank budgets and stores the resulting data in a low-rank KV cache.
In the subsequent inference stage, an input query is first evaluated by a retriever to perform KV selection from this compressed storage.
The selected low-rank cache segments then undergo full-rank reconstruction in parallel.
Finally, the reconstructed KV cache and the original input query are processed together through a sparse attention mechanism to complete the generation.

通过分析每个区块的Entropy,系统根据所分配的级别预算应用低级压缩,并将由此产生的数据存储在低级的KV缓存中.

blocks.en: 4.5 System Optimizations
blocks.zh: 4.5 系统优化

blocks.en: To translate MILO’s memory savings into end-to-end speedup, we optimize the reconstruction path with fused Triton kernels, CUDA streams, and CUDA Graphs.
blocks.zh: 为了将MILO的内存节省转化为端到端的加速,我们优化了三联内核、CUDA流和CUDA图的重建路径。

blocks.en:
Fused Low-Rank Reconstruction. A naive PyTorch-based implementation requires separate kernels for loading low-rank
factors, applying singular-value scaling, reconstructing KV tensors, and
writing them back to global memory.
We instead implement a fused Triton
kernel that performs cache retrieval, scaling, and reconstruction in a
single pass.
The kernel tiles the token and head dimensions, computes the reconstructed keys and values in registers and on-chip SRAM, and writes
them directly to the KV buffer consumed by attention.
This reduces both intermediate HBM traffic and intermediate kernel-launch overhead.

单传.

这既减少了中间HBM的流量,也减少了中间内核发射的俯冲.

blocks.en:
Parallel Reconstruction with CUDA Streams. Rather than reconstructing them sequentially on the default stream, MILO dispatches independent blocks to multiple CUDA streams to enable block-level parallelism and synchronizes only before sparse attention.
This improves GPU utilization for small reconstruction kernels and reduces reconstruction latency on the critical path.

这改善了GPU对小型重建内核的利用,并减少了关键路径上的重建延迟.

blocks.en:

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Accuracy Results. Table 1 reports the detailed accuracy results of our method and baseline methods.
Under an identical rank budget constraint, our method outperforms prior state-of-the-art low-rank methods, improving the accuracy performance by up to 4.5%.
Specifically, on Qwen2.5-3B, MILO demonstrates a consistent lead across all individual tasks, substantially narrowing the empirical performance gap to the accuracy performance upper bound.
A similar trend can be observed on the larger Qwen2.5-7B model, where MILO retains a greater proportion of the full cache representation capacity, significantly outperforming SOTA methods.
blocks.zh:
准确性结果。 表1报告我们的方法和基准方法的详细准确性结果。
在一个相同的排名预算限制下,我们的方法优于之前最先进的低排名方法,精确性提高了高达4.5%.
具体地说,在Quen2.5-3B上,MILO在所有单个任务上都表现出一致的领先性,大大缩小了经验性性能差距到精度性能的上限.
在较大的Quen2.5-7B模型上也可以看到类似的趋势,MILO保留了较大比例的全缓存代表能力,大大超过SOTA方法.

blocks.en:
Throughput Results. We further evaluate the system performance of MILO under a memory-constrained deployment.
Since the KV cache often cannot remain resident in GPU memory, we consider a KV offloading configuration where pre-encoded cache blocks for many-shot examples are stored in CPU memory and transferred to the GPU on demand during query processing Sheng et al. (2023) ; Zhao et al. (2024) .
Figure 4 reports the end-to-end throughput comparison.
Here, we have two key observations.
First, compared with full KV offloading, MILO achieves an average speedup of 1.6 × \times , thanks to the reduced KV volume by performing low-rank compression and efficient kernel implementation.
For instance, for the 7B model with 512-shot inputs, MILO can sustain up to 3.2 × \times more throughput.
Second, MILO outperforms Palu and ASVD by up to 37% and 60%, respectively.
Third, the larger the model size, the higher the improvement MILO brings.
This is due to the increased KV cache size transferred during offload, thus making the inference more memory-bound.

blocks.en: 5.3 Performance Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 业绩分析

blocks.en:
Impact of Rank Budget and Block Size. Figure 5 (a) and (b) demonstrate the sensitivity of MILO to the compression ratio and block size (number of examples per block).
Here, we have two key observations.
First, as the compression ratio increases, all low-rank methods experience gradual accuracy degradation due to the reduced rank budget.
However, MILO consistently maintains higher accuracy than ASVD and Palu across the entire range.
This indicates that the proposed block-wise adaptive allocation preserves more task-relevant information under constrained rank budgets.
Second, increasing the block size initially improves both model accuracy and system efficiency, as larger blocks expose more cross-example redundancy that can be captured by the low-rank representation.
However, both accuracy and speedup begin to decline after a certain block size (32), suggesting that overly large blocks reduce compression and retrieval granularity while increasing reconstruction overhead.
blocks.zh:
排名预算和块大小的影响。 图5(a)和(b)显示MILO对压缩比率和块大小(每个块的例子数)的敏感性。
这里,我们有两个关键的意见。
第一,随着压缩比的提高,所有低级方法都因军衔预算的减少而逐渐发生精度下降.
然而,MILO在整个范围内始终保持比ASVD和Palu更高的精度.
这表明,拟议的区块适应性分配在受限制的级别预算之下保留了与任务相关的更多信息。
第二,增加块大小最初会提高模型精度和系统效率,因为较大的块会暴露出更多的跨实例冗余,这些冗余可以被低阶代表所捕捉.
然而,精度和速度在一定块大小(32)后开始下降,这表明过于大的块会减少压缩和检索颗粒性,同时增加重建间接费用.

blocks.en:
Kernel Performance Analysis. We further evaluate the effectiveness of the system optimizations for MILO, as shown in Figure 5 (c).
The native PyTorch implementation incurs substantial latency from separate cache loading, low-rank reconstruction, cache storage, and repeated kernel launches.
Replacing these operations with our fused Triton implementation reduces kernel latency by approximately 2.5 × 2.5\times , primarily by eliminating intermediate HBM traffic.
Enabling parallel block reconstruction with CUDA streams further improves the speedup to approximately 3.3 × 3.3\times and combining with CUDA graph achieves a total speedup of approximately 3.7 × 3.7\times over the PyTorch implementation.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we present MILO, a block-wise low-rank KV-cache compression framework for efficient many-shot in-context learning.
By exploiting heterogeneous low-rank redundancy across demonstration blocks and dynamically allocating a global rank budget, MILO reduces KV cache memory footprint by 50% while preserving model accuracy.
Combining with customized fused Triton kernels, MILO further improves the system performance, achieving up 1.8 × \times speedup upon existing baseline methods, demonstrating a practical path toward efficient many-shot ICL inference.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们介绍了MILO,一个以块为单位的低级KV卡切压缩框架,用于高效的多镜头内文学习.
MILO通过利用不同演示区块的低级冗余和动态分配全球排名预算,将KV缓存内存足迹减少50%,同时保持模型精度.
MILO与定制的已熔化的Triton内核结合,进一步提高了系统性能,在现有基准方法上实现了1.8×\时速的加速,展示了通往高效的多镜头ICL推论的实用路径.
